VBO:0200053.summary: Dignified and gentle are the traits emphasized in the American Mastiff standard, which describes well-trained dogs as calm, controlled and confident. The breed was developed at Flying W Farms in Ohio from Mastiff and Anatolian ancestry. Its registry maintains a defined breeding lineage rather than accepting every similar-looking mastiff.
VBO:0200053.shortDescription: A dignified, gentle mastiff lineage developed in Ohio; its standard emphasizes calm confidence in well-trained dogs.

sources.title: Continental Kennel Club — American Mastiff standard and breeding history
sources.evidence: Entire actual CKC body read: dignity/gentleness; calm controlled confident explicitly conditioned on well-trained dogs. Fredericka Wagner/Flying W Farms/PiketonOhio program and English/Anatolian early crossing stated. January2000 recognition only CKC AR-numbered descendants accepted. Literal broad clean-cut rectangular head with real muzzle2:3 to1:2 skull ratio, natural V-drop ears, elbow-deep chest/level balanced slightly longer body, coherent strong legs/compact feet and natural full hock-length high-inserted tail straight/gently curved/not overback. Short smooth fawn/apricot/brindle with blackmask selected. No child safety, guaranteed defense, health improvements, reduced drooling or unselected rating-slider values used.

VBO:0200011.summary: Strongly attached to its familiar people, the Aksaray Malaklisi is described as territorial and suspicious of strangers. This central Turkish guardian watches livestock and property around Aksaray, where its work is woven into local husbandry. A regional gene-bank project reported preserving the population’s genetic material in 2016.
VBO:0200011.shortDescription: A territorial central Turkish livestock guardian, described as strongly attached to its familiar people.

sources.title: Aksaray University e-Şehir Encyclopedia — Aksaray Malaklısı, Dr Tamer Kayar
sources.evidence: Credited university account describes attachment to owner, territorial protection and response to unfamiliar perceived threats, plus established livestock guarding in Aksaray and neighboring central Anatolia. Anatomy explicitly heavy head/pendent lips, long muscular body, short coat and less tightly curled tail than Kangal.

sources.title: WAD — Malaklı
sources.evidence: Maintaining Turkish cynology association describes strong attachment to familiar household people, suspicion toward strangers and flock/territory protection around Aksaray. Literal adult size and heavy broad head/blunt muzzle/pendent lips/loose neck/short coat supply anatomy.

sources.title: Ün et al. (2016) — Establishment of Malaklı Dog Regional Gene Bank, publisher abstract
sources.evidence: Actual complete publisher abstract reports taking, processing and storing Malakli genetic material for a regional gene bank. Used only for narrow reported2016 preservation work, no empirical temperament, genetic-purity result, pedigree recognition or health benefit.
